newsitem.title: USA: JWT hires Ammirati's Spivak for top creative role.
newsitem.headline: JWT hires Ammirati's Spivak for top creative role.

text.p: WPP Plc's J Walter Thompson scored a coup Friday by announcing the hiring of Helayne Spivak, who only recently had been named worldwide creative director of Interpublic Group's Ammirati Puris Lintas.
Spivak will become chief creative officer-North America and worldwide creative director for JWT, the world's third-biggest adveritising agency, with $6.77 billion in billings.

In late summer, Spivak was promoted to the worldwide creative position at Ammirati, where she had worked for a number of years. She has also worked at Ally and Gargano, Hal Riney & Partners and Young & Rubicam.

Spivak will be responsible for North American creative work and for some selected global clients. She will report directly to Chris Jones, co-president and CEO-designate of J. Walter Thompson Worldwide.
